description: This file is a shell script used for restarting, rebuilding, and managing the OpenClaw application. It performs tasks such as killing running instances, rebuilding binaries, signing or unsigned setup, packaging the app, choosing the app bundle, installing launch agents, and launching the app.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message to the standard output with a newline.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Logs the step label and executes the command; fails if the command fails.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the lock directory if it exists.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent simultaneous restarts; waits if another process holds the lock.

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks for available code signing identities.

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of OpenClaw and related processes.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent associated with OpenClaw.
